THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 16.11.2023, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 CRL. M.C. NO.9676 OF 2023  3  P.V.KUNHIKRISHNAN, J.
 --------------------------------
 Crl.M.C. No.9676 of 2023  -------------------------------------
 Dated this the 16th day of November, 2023  ORDER
This Criminal Miscellaneous Case is filed to quash the F.I.R. in Crime No.620/2020 of Vallikunnam Police Station.

The F.I.R. is registered alleging offences punishable under Sections 452, 465, 467,
468, 469, 471, 420 and 120(B) r/w 34 of IPC.

The petitioner want to quash the F.I.R. stating that no offence is made out based on the averments in the F.I.R.
2.
I am of the considered opinion that this is not a case in which the F.I.R. is to be quashed.

But, I CRL. M.C. NO.9676 OF 2023 make it clear that, if any, final report is filed by the police against the petitioner, the petitioner is free to challenge the same by filing a separate Criminal Miscellaneous Case.
Granting liberty to the petitioner to challenge the final report, if any, filed and if the petitioner is aggrieved by the same, this Criminal Miscellaneous Case is closed.
